scope: Previously seen and development-tuned evaluation suite; not fresh generalization, isolated agent-count evidence, or fleet throughput. No CPU search, retry, or cross-case memory.

scheduling.order: Stored task order within seeds 1,2,3; four persistent host queues, one active case per node.

admission: Fresh UTC age 0..900 seconds; root-verified same runtime, owner/image/model/draft/health/idle; exact runner/protocol/test and frozen 638 source hashes plus four distinct endpoints.
stop_policy: A deadline remains an outcome with partial/unknown costs retained. Positive controller, transport, source, counter, or drain faults stop new admission; in-flight owned cases finish/drain. Local exceptions set stop before recording.
output: Original traces, request IDs, own reasoning lineage, actual usage, completion caps, controller stops, drain/counter coverage and hashes preserved. No original 900-case source or scores changed.
